		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { LR_vol_FNG > 0 } } }
				FNG = {
					division_template = {
						name = "Volontaires Francais"
						regiments = {
							infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 }
							infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 }
							infantry = { x = 0 y = 2 }
							infantry = { x = 1 y = 0 }
							infantry = { x = 1 y = 1 }
							infantry = { x = 1 y = 2 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add_to_variable = { LR_vol_FNG = 1 }
			add_manpower = -8000
			send_equipment = {
				target = FNG
				type = infantry_equipment
				amount = 1000
			}
			FNG = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = small_increase } }
			create_unit = {
				division = "division_template = \"Volontaires Francais\" start_experience_factor = 0.3"
				owner = FNG
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
	}
